name: The Last Guild
storyline: The Last Guild is a classic third-person RPG with turn-based combat! Powerful beings are on the rise, and the Kingdom is counting on the last guild to exterminate the forces of darkness. Do you have what it takes to restore order to the world? Choose your adventurers to help restore peace and order to the Kingdom! The Last Guild combines classic RPG heritage with other innovative mechanics, creating an RPG experience like no other! The game will feature several adventures as if it had a Master running classic RPG campaigns, from which the player will benefit from new content.
summary: An RPG full of combat and regions to explore, focused on collecting resources to create magical items and defeat monsters. You are the last defender of this kingdom, hire adventurers to help you on your journey.
